# `project` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/project.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

The single project row (doc 03 §5, rank 10): master data, parties, supply and settings.

Not in v0 (later work packages; a file that carries them keeps them in `extra`): `user_prop_defs`
(no field-level definition yet), `completed` (revisions, doc 15 §5.10) and the settings schemes listed
at `ProjectSettings`.

## Types

### BasicProjectRef

The basic project a project was created from (FR-PRJ-009, WP-S1.19 D14): its project ID and its manifest
generation when it was copied (a basic project has no semantic version).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `generation` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) | yes |  | The basic project's manifest generation when it was copied. |
| `id` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The basic project's project ID. |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### LangTag

A canonical BCP 47 language tag such as en-GB (language in lower case, script in title case, region in upper case). JSON Schema cannot express that variant and extension subtags are unique; no registry is consulted, so qq-QQ is accepted.

Type: string (at least 2 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:[a-z]{2,3}(?:-[a-z]{3}){0,3}|[a-z]{4,8})(?:-[A-Z][a-z]{3})?(?:-(?:[A-Z]{2}|[0-9]{3}))?(?:-(?:[a-z0-9]{5,8}|[0-9][a-z0-9]{3}))*(?:-[a-wy-z0-9](?:-[a-z0-9]{2,8})+)*(?:-x(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})+)?$`

| `revision_label` | [`LabelFormat`](#labelformat) or `null` | no |  | The project's one revision label format (doc 15 §5.2, FR-REV-002; WP-S1.18 D2); absent means `v_major_minor`, the golden form (`ProjectSettings::revision_label_format`). |
| `text_styles` | map of [`TextStyleSpec`](#textstylespec) | no |  | The text styles as overrides of the built-in table of doc 20 §17.5, by style key (ADR-0032): a key of the table takes the entry's size and weight, any other key adds a style. Absent is the built-in table. |

### LabelFormat

The project's one revision label format (doc 15 §5.2, FR-REV-002), `ProjectSettings.revision_label`;
absent means `LabelFormat::VMajorMinor`, the golden form, so every file written before the setting existed
reads as it did.

Labels increase in the format's own order (`LabelFormat::order_key`): `V2.0 < V10.0`, `09 < 10`, `Z < AA`.
That is not the natural (text) order everywhere: natural order puts `AA` before `Z`, so every ranking of
revisions orders by this key (labels outside the format, which it does not order, by their natural order).
The proposal for the next revision bumps the major part (`LabelFormat::next`).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"v_major_minor"` | `V{major}.{minor}`: V1.0, V2.0, V2.1 (decimal parts without leading zeros). |
| `"two_digit"` | `{nn}`: 00, 01 … 99, 100 (decimal, at least two digits: one leading zero below ten). |
| `"letter"` | `{A}`: A, B … Z, AA, AB … (the letters without I and O, counted like spreadsheet columns). |

### Quantity

A decimal value with its unit (doc 03 §3.2): `{"value": Dec3, "unit": Unit}`. Rendering ("0.75 mm²",
decimal comma in nl and de) is a query, never stored text (D-18).

```
use ew_schema::{Quantity, Unit};

let q: Quantity = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"value":"20","unit":"A"}"#).unwrap();
assert_eq!(q.unit, Unit::A);
assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&q).unwrap(), r#"{"value":"20","unit":"A"}"#);
```

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | [`Unit`](#unit) | yes |  | Its unit. |
| `value` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) | yes |  | The number. |

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### TextStyleSpec

One entry of `ProjectSettings.text_styles`: an override of a built-in style or a new style (ADR-0032).

Family, italic and alignment are not typed (the bundled face is the only family at MVP, ADR-0028; alignment
belongs to the slot) and stay in `extra`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | [`Nm`](#nm) | yes |  | The em height in nm, 500,000 … 50,000,000 (0.5 mm … 50 mm). |
| `weight` | [`TextWeight`](#textweight) or `null` | no |  | The weight; absent keeps the built-in row's weight (regular for a new style). |

### Nm

A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

Type: integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)

### TextWeight

The weight of a text style (ADR-0032 decision 1).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"regular"` | Regular. |
| `"bold"` | Bold. |

The units of doc 03 §3.2 and the order units of FR-PRT-026. Persisted as the unit symbol in ASCII
(`"mm2"`, `"degC"`), so files stay greppable; rendering uses the typographic symbol.

| `"mm2"` | Square millimetre (cross-sections). |
| `"A"` | Ampere. |
| `"V"` | Volt. |
| `"Hz"` | Hertz. |
| `"bar"` | Bar (pressure). |
| `"degC"` | Degree Celsius. |
| `"kg"` | Kilogram. |
| `"W"` | Watt. |
| `"m"` | Metre (lengths and the order unit of cables). |
| `"piece"` | Piece (the default order unit). |
| `"set"` | Set (order unit). |
